comment: Approved new-rule numbers as validated data (framework contract sections: Mana and Stamina, Weight Class and Dodge Roll, Unarmed fallback, Deck composition). No formula constant lives in code.

stamina.combatStartRefillNote: Owner's call, 2026-09-24 (plan A2): every fight opens with Stamina at its maximum ('full'); 'carry' opens it where the last fight left it. Mana still carries between fights and only rests, flasks and effects restore it. Measured with every #1284 row live, `node tools/runsim.mjs 120 --seeded-seats` (seat order drawn per run, 120 runs a class): full gives Reaver 51, Starseer 51, Rogue 69, Herald 66 wins; carry gives Reaver 35, Starseer 28, Rogue 43, Herald 75.

classes.dodgeCostNote: Plan A3, 2026-09-24: Medium 2 Stamina / 1 Action -> 1 / 1, Heavy 3 / 2 -> 2 / 1. Under the derived-stat rows of #1273 the class presets open on 1 Stamina (Starseer) or 2 (the rest), so Heavy's 3 was more than any preset's whole pool and Medium's 2 more than the Starseer's. Now Light and Medium fit every preset's pool and Heavy fits every pool but the Starseer's; the three still rank Light 1/0, Medium 1/1, Heavy 2/1, with Heavy's -3 evasion and 0 guard as the rest of its cost. Measured with node tools/runsim.mjs 240 --seeded-seats: putting Medium back to 2 Stamina costs the Reaver (the one class the bot plays Medium) 3 wins of 240; the bot never plays Heavy, so the Heavy row is not measured there.

weight.itemWeightScaleNote: Owner's call, 2026-09-24: rescale item weights, not capacity, after the lean attribute rebase (2026-09-20) cut capacity (2*CON + STR) to 3-12 while authored weights stayed on the old scale, so every creatable start was Heavy. Every piece weight (an armament's authored weight, an armour's poise threshold) is multiplied by this and kept to a tenth. Chosen with tools/weightclass-census.mjs over 0.15-0.25: at 0.2 the class-preset starts are 84 Light and 28 Medium with none Heavy, and every class still reaches Heavy with its heaviest kit (Reaver 94%, Rogue and Herald 116%, Starseer 193%). 0.18 is the lowest scale at which the Reaver reaches Heavy; above 0.22 preset starts turn Heavy. The min-capacity allocation (Constitution and Strength at their minimum) has 14 Heavy starts of 76 at 0.2; no scale both keeps those off Heavy and lets the Reaver reach Heavy.
weight.capacityBaseNote: Was 50, then 5. Validated by tools/weightclass-census.mjs (2026-09-01). The census covers the creator's space: the two VISIBLE creation modes (standard, pointbuy), and for each not only the class preset but the two allocation boundaries that bracket capacity (Constitution and Strength at their legal minimum, and at their legal maximum), every armour choice, and each hand chosen independently (empty allowed, the same armament twice refused), with every pair passed through the creator's own requirement gate (startingHandsRequirementFailure — a sheet that cannot hold a Greatsword does not start with one; 100 pairs refused). Reachability is every ordered pair of distinct armaments through a real loadout with the outfit at its highest Smithing tier, at the standard preset. Base 50 left even the heaviest reachable kit Light: the class did not exist for the player. Base 5 (the first retune) leaves no class able to reach Heavy at the standard preset (Reaver 76%, Starseer 74%, Rogue 74%, Herald 71%). Bases 0 and 1 are the only ones at which every class reaches Heavy (base 0: Reaver 86%, Starseer 86%, Rogue 86%, Herald 82%; base 2 already loses the Herald at 77%); 0 is chosen because capacity is then exactly 2*CON + STR with no free constant. At 0 the preset starts are 200 Light and 24 Medium; the min-capacity boundary starts are 144 Light and 28 Medium and the max-capacity boundary 172 Light and 4 Medium — no creatable start is Heavy, because the same requirements that gate a heavy armament also demand the Strength that raises capacity.

dodgeRoll.retuneNote: Plan A3, 2026-09-24. The Dexterity term was floor((DEX - 10) / 2), a d20-scale habit: on the lean scale (1 at baseline, 4 at the creation ceiling) it read -3 to -5 for every creatable character (-4 or -5 for every class preset), so a preset's guard 3 + term + class guard was 2 at best when Light, 0 when Medium and negative when Heavy, and a landed dodge usually granted nothing. The term is now floor((DEX - dexterityCentre) / dexterityPerModifier) = floor((DEX - 3) / 2) for a run made on the lean scale (dexterityCentreByMode.lean): 0 at a class's primary 3, -1 at the baseline 1, +1 at 5, +2 at 7. With the Dexterity minimum of 1 a landed dodge now guards at least 2 (Heavy at DEX 1), so no floor row is needed. Measured with node tools/runsim.mjs 240 --seeded-seats --deep (class presets): dodges landed 35-44% of plays for 0.6 (Reaver) to 2.0 (Rogue) guard each before, 57-65% for 4.4-6.0 after; wins went Reaver 105 -> 112, Starseer 103 -> 104, Rogue 135 -> 141, Herald 135 -> 136 of 240 with the Medium price row, spread 13.3 -> 15.4 points. A run made under an older creation mode (tuned2, tuned, standard, pointbuy, an admitted in-flight save) keeps the d20-scale centre dexterityCentre 10, so an update never moves its dodge.
